review.intent_summary: Callers can submit ordered numeric values or versioned requests containing datasets, settings, context, and declared relationships.

criteria.criterion: Ordered value lists work with separate settings, while schema 1.0 requests describe one dataset.
Schema 1.1 datasets declare a nonempty entity scope and support explicit relationships between named datasets.
Unknown settings, unsupported recipes, nonfinite values, booleans, and numeric strings are rejected.
Published schema 1.0 and 1.1 request and result schemas match the public Python contracts.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Read README input/API examples and schema-version limits; independently parsed all four published schemas and asserted equality to their current public contracts.
